faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers about website development and working together

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: A landing page starts from €299, a business website from €599, and a more complex web application from €1,499. The final price depends on features, design complexity, and timeline.

items.q: How long does it take to build a website?
items.a: A simple landing page takes 3-5 business days, a business website takes 7-10 days, and a web application takes 14-21 business days. The timeline depends on project scope.
I build modern websites using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. For backend I use Supabase, and for payments I use Stripe. This ensures speed, security, and SEO performance.
Yes, every website I build is fully responsive and adapts to phones, tablets, and desktop screens. This is essential for both SEO and user experience.

items.q: Will the website be optimized for Google search?
items.a: Yes, every project includes SEO fundamentals: speed, meta tags, semantic HTML, structured data, and a mobile version. I can also perform a comprehensive SEO audit if needed.

items.q: Where are you based and who do you work with?
items.a: I am based in Brussels, Belgium, and work with clients from Lithuania, Belgium, and worldwide. All communication happens via email, video calls, and project management tools.

items.q: Do I need my own domain and hosting?
items.a: No. I can help register a domain and choose hosting that fits your needs. I usually recommend Vercel or similar solutions for fast and secure performance.

items.q: What does the website development process look like?
items.a: We start with a short call to understand your goals. Then I prepare a proposal, design the site, get your approval, develop it and launch it. I keep close communication throughout the process.

items.q: Can I update the website content after launch?
items.a: Yes. Business website and web application packages include an admin panel where you can edit content yourself. I also offer additional technical support when needed.
Each stage includes up to 3 free revisions. This lets us align the design and functionality so the final result fully matches your expectations.

landing-page.metaDescription: Professional landing page development for businesses in Lithuania, Belgium and worldwide. Single-page site with contact form, mobile version and SEO basics. From €299.
landing-page.title: Landing Page Design & Development
landing-page.lead: A landing page is a single-page website built for one specific purpose: turning a visitor into a customer. Whether you are launching a new product, collecting leads, or running a limited-time promotion, a clearly structured page builds trust and drives action. I create fast, beautiful and technically solid landing pages that look great on mobile and deliver measurable results.
landing-page.forWhom: This solution is ideal for startups, solo professionals, beauty and wellness providers, real estate agents, consultants, and any business that needs to present one focused offer and capture inquiries quickly.
includes: Unique single-page design aligned with your brand
Clear offer presentation and smooth user journey
Contact form with email notifications
Fully responsive layout for phones and tablets
Basic SEO: meta tags, speed, semantic HTML
Social Open Graph tags and sharing preview
Launch assistance to get the page live

process.desc: Through a short call we clarify what you are selling, who the message is for, and the desired visitor action.
I prepare a commercial proposal and page structure: headline, benefits, offer, social proof, and contact section.
I create a visual mockup. You request revisions until the design fully matches your expectations.
I code the page with modern technologies and test speed, mobile layout, and form functionality.
The site goes live, the domain is connected, and you receive access instructions.

faq.q: Is a landing page right for my business?
faq.a: If you have one main offer and want visitors to fill a form, call, or buy, a landing page is one of the most effective solutions.

faq.q: Can I update the landing page content myself?
faq.a: In the standard package content is prepared before launch. If you need frequent updates, I recommend a business website with a content admin panel.

faq.q: How long does it take to build a landing page?
faq.a: Typically 3-5 business days, provided all texts and brand materials are ready.

faq.q: Are domain and hosting included in the price?
faq.a: No, domain and hosting are purchased separately. I can help you choose the right hosting and launch the site at no extra cost.

business-website.metaDescription: Modern 4-6 page business website with admin panel and SEO optimization. Working with clients in Lithuania, Belgium and worldwide. From €599.
business-website.title: Business Website Development
business-website.lead: A business website is your digital office where visitors learn about your services, team, projects, and how to contact you. I build 4-6 page websites that not only look professional but are also easy to manage, fast to load, and ready for Google search. Every project is tailored to a specific business rather than pulled from a template.
business-website.forWhom: This solution fits small and medium-sized companies, legal, finance, beauty, construction, real estate, and consulting service providers who want a convincing online presence and the ability to update content themselves.
includes: 4-6 unique pages tailored to your business needs
Admin dashboard for editing content
Contact forms and social media integration
Services, projects, or team presentation sections
Full SEO optimization: structure, meta tags, speed
Mobile and tablet optimization
Optional blog module
Post-launch guide for managing the site

process.desc: We clarify business goals, target audience, competitors, and what makes your offer different.
We define the page map, content structure, and visuals that best represent your brand.
I create the visual style and key page mockups. We revise until the design feels truly yours.
I code the site with admin management, connect forms, and optimize performance and security.
I check functionality across devices, deploy the site, and hand over access.

faq.q: Does a business website include an admin panel?
faq.a: Yes, the standard package includes an admin dashboard where you can edit page content, update images, and manage blog posts.

faq.q: How many pages can I have?
faq.a: The standard business website covers 4-6 pages. More pages can be added and priced according to scope.

faq.q: Can I add a blog or news section?
faq.a: Yes, a blog module can be added on request. It is especially useful for SEO and keeping content fresh.

faq.q: Will I be able to manage the site without coding skills?
faq.a: Yes, the admin dashboard is simple and intuitive. I provide instructions at launch and remain available for support.

web-application.metaDescription: Custom web applications with user accounts, database, and payments. Next.js, Supabase, Stripe. Working with startups and businesses in Lithuania, Belgium and worldwide. From €1,499.
web-application.title: Web Application Development
web-application.lead: A web application is an interactive solution where users can register, manage data, make payments, and access unique features. I build SaaS platforms, internal business systems, dashboards, and MVP products using modern technologies: Next.js, Supabase, and Stripe. Every application is built with security, speed, and future scalability in mind.
web-application.forWhom: This solution is for startups building new digital products, companies looking to automate internal processes, and businesses planning subscription or paid-access platforms.
includes: User registration, login, and account management
Database and server logic with Supabase
Payment integration through Stripe
Personal user dashboard or admin panel
API integrations and third-party services
Security basics: roles, sessions, data validation
Responsive design for desktop and mobile devices
Technical documentation and launch support

process.desc: We clarify the problem the app solves, core features, business model, and technical requirements.
I create a data model, user flows, and a simple prototype so you can see the key screens.
I design the full interface with usability, accessibility, and mobile use in mind.
I build the frontend, backend, authentication, and payments, then test functionality, security, and load.
The app is deployed to production, monitoring is connected, and we discuss ongoing support.

faq.q: How is a web application different from a business website?
faq.a: A web application has user accounts, interactive functionality, a database, and often payments. A business website is mainly informational and promotional.

faq.q: Can you build just an MVP?
faq.a: Yes, I often work with startups on the first product version. The MVP includes the core features needed to validate the idea.
I use secure authentication, server-side data validation, query protection, and best practices for safeguarding user data.
Yes, I can integrate payments, email, calendars, AI APIs, and other services depending on project needs.
